texts.orig: III. COHERENT ISING MACHINE

texts.label: text
texts.orig: In this section, we introduce Coherent Ising Machine (CIM) and explain its application to solving our multi-objective routing model.
texts.text: In this section, we introduce Coherent Ising Machine (CIM) and explain its application to solving our multi-objective routing model.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: CIM is a quantum-inspired optimization technique that leverages principles from the Ising model. The Ising model represents optimization problems as energy minimization tasks, where the goal is to find the ground state of a system by minimizing its energy. In the context of combinatorial optimization, this ground state corresponds to an optimal or near-optimal solution. CIM utilizes an optical network of degenerate optical parametric oscillators (DOPOs) to represent spins in the Ising model. Each DOPO encodes the spin states using phase-coherent laser pulses, with the two possible phases corresponding to spin values of +1 or -1 . The system's energy is minimized by continuously adjusting the pump power, allowing CIM to evolve the spin states toward lower energy configurations and find solutions to the optimization problem.
